scoring.note: Scores are published PER KIND, never pooled: censorship and FX have different resolvers, base-rate estimators and dependence structures, so a row-weighted average across them is dominated by whichever wrote more rows. Skill is withheld for any kind until it has resolved in at least 3 independent batches — with one batch there is no way to separate forecasting skill from the fortnight the world happened to have.
